newsitem.title: USA: Green Oasis gets $7.2 mln buy order.
newsitem.headline: Green Oasis gets $7.2 mln buy order.

text.p: Green Oasis Environmental Inc said on Tuesday it received a purchase order for four Model 600 EnviroEconomics (TM) processing units from Midwest Fuel Refining Inc for a total of $7.2 million.
These four units, which cost $1.8 million each, are to be scheduled for delivery over the next two years.

In addition to the revenues generated by the sale of the units, Green Oasis will receive an annual royalty of $0.04 per gallon of diesel fuel produced, or approximately $250,000 per unit, per year, for 20 years.
Green Oasis Environmental Inc's patent pending process produces synthetic fuels from waste motor oil in a closed-cycle, one-step process.
